items.name: Junk Scrap
items.description:
Random pieces of discarded kipple, often useless but 
may serve a purpose.

items.name: Tech Scrap
items.description:
Jumbled fragments of outdated tech, their components 
buzzing with the potential for some future use.

items.name: Metal Scrap
items.description:
Shards of old metal, can be recycled or used in 
crafting.

items.name: Telemetry Module
items.description:
Electronics box used to collect measurements and data 
for monitoring and analysis.

items.name: Phaneton Battery
items.description:
Battery containing refined Phaneton Condensate. Emits
a faint persistant hum. Used as a power source.

items.name: Wires
items.description:
Thin, sturdy strands of metal, flexible but strong.
Perfect for binding or short-term connections.

items.name: Wire Spool
items.description:
A roll of wire, coiled tightly and ready for any task.
Its use only limited by your imagination. Very pointy.

items.name: Magnetic Material
items.description:
A dense, metallic substance that hums with unnatural 
magnetism, pulsing with attractive power...

items.name: Phanteton Condensate Cartridge
items.description:
Writable Hard Imipolex Phaneton Condensate Cartridge.
Use to record Interference Pattern of your Phaneron.

items.name: Textile Filament
items.description:
Textile filament for 3d printing. Textile properties
based on the weave pattern of the printed filament.

items.name: Uncured Imipolex Resin
items.description:
Imipolex resin for 3d printing both specialised and 
basic Imipolex plastics.

items.name: Imipolex Cube
items.description:
A compact, dense block of synthetic material, its 
surfaces shifting subtly beyond comprehension.

items.name: Metallic Filament
items.description:
Filament infused with metal for 3D printing, ideal for 
durable, high-strength creations.

items.name: Organoid Plug
items.description:
A bio-mechanical plug carrying data and metabolic 
support between organoid or machine devices.

items.name: Organoid Socket
items.description:
A receptive interface that identifies, conditions and 
accepts organoid and organoid to machine connections.

items.name: Organoid Phosphor CRT
items.description:
A phosphor display adapted to render the unstable 
signals of organoid computers.

items.name: Neuro Uplink Board
items.description:
A neural interface translating human nervous impulses 
into machine commands.

items.name: Organoid Networking Board
items.description:
A wetware communications board linking organoid 
computers and external systems.

items.name: Organoid Memory Board
items.description:
A cultivated memory lattice for storing data, learned 
behavior and experience.

items.name: Muther Board
items.description:
A bio-mechanical backplane that binds and sustains an 
organoid computer system.

items.name: Organoid Processor
items.description:
A sealed neural computing module housing a cultivated 
artificial intelligence.

items.name: Psy Block
items.description:
A foil blister pack of pink ephemerol tablets. Blocks 
nerve cascade impulse common with psychic phenomena.
